annotations.title: Get a company's forward PIT history

description: Read EquiReason's forward-observed revision ledger as of an ISO date or offset timestamp. Coverage starts at the system's first capture for each domain: values before that capture are unknown, not reconstructed, and overwritten pre-ledger intraday data is not recovered. Each row carries revision, fiscal period, basis, source lineage, first-seen and observed-at. Requires signing in; financial, estimate, guidance, verdict and transcript-reading domains follow the plan's existing feature entitlements. Bounded paging with cursor/high_watermark.

as_of.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) or timestamp with offset, e.g. 2026-11-05T14:00:00Z

domains.description: Optional domains; omit for all available domains

high_watermark.description: high_watermark from the first page; pins the snapshot

name: get_company_history
